title: The Aftermath Frame
idiom: hand-inked manga/comic aftermath drawing — sumi-brush pen-flow ink
hero_prompt: A hand-inked pen-and-ink comic drawing of a swordswoman frozen an instant after a downward strike on a stone column — shards and dust hang mid-flight, torn air-lines trail from the blade, her robe still whipping from the follow-through. Bold sumi-brush linework, dynamic speed-lines, dramatic black-and-white contrast with a single warm ink wash.
icon_prompt: A bold woodcut-style icon of a single curved speed-line trailing off a cracked shard, rendered as thick black ink strokes on white, no fine detail, reading instantly as motion-after-impact at small size.
